about: The epistola of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Having gifts differing according to the grace that is given us, whether prophecy, let it be according to the rule of faith; or ministry, in ministering; or he that teacheth, in doctrine; he that exhorteth, in exhorting; he that giveth, with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness. Let love be without dissimulation. Hate that which is evil; cleave to that which is good. Love one another with the charity of brotherhood; in honor preferring one another. Be not slothful in diligence; be fervent in spirit; serve the Lord. Rejoice in hope; be patient in tribulation; persevere in prayer. Communicate to the necessities of the saints; pursue hospitality. Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not. Rejoice with them that rejoice and weep with them that weep. Be of one mind toward one another. Mind not high things, but consent to the humble.
